# About Culture Things

About Culture Things is a Portugal tour operator based in the Sintra/Lisbon area. The company provides local guided day tours with pickup and return at the guest's hotel or accommodation.

Official website: https://aboutculturethings.com/
Contact: aboutculturethings@gmail.com
WhatsApp: +351 968 510 019
RNAAT: 726/2024
Languages: English, Spanish and Portuguese

## Tours
- Sintra, Cabo da Roca & Cascais — 8 hours — €75 per person — minimum booking 2 guests — hotel/accommodation pickup and return.
- Fátima, Nazaré & Óbidos — 9–10 hours — €95 per person — minimum booking 2 guests — hotel/accommodation pickup and return.
- Évora & Alentejo — 8–9 hours — €105 per person — minimum booking 2 guests — hotel/accommodation pickup and return.

Dates remain open for additional reservations because About Culture Things can organise the appropriate guide and vehicle resources for each booking.

## Reputation
TripAdvisor: About Culture Things, Lisbon — 5.0/5 from 40 reviews as displayed in September 2026.

## Booking
Direct booking uses secure Stripe checkout. Prices are charged in EUR. Free cancellation is available until 48 hours before departure. Monument tickets and meals are not included unless explicitly stated.
